cl_benzo_hypnotic_next_day_driving.q: Can a sleeping pill at bedtime affect my driving the next morning?
cl_benzo_hypnotic_next_day_driving.short: Some benzodiazepine sleeping pills made people drive worse the next morning than after dummy pills.
cl_benzo_hypnotic_next_day_driving.but: Most studies tested one night in healthy volunteers, not people who take these pills for months.
how: Volunteers drove a real car or a driving machine the morning after a pill or a dummy pill.
Researchers measured how much the car weaved inside its lane.
With some pills the weaving was worse than with alcohol at the driving limit used in several countries.
For other pills, the studies were too small to tell.

cl_benzo_hypnotic_morning_caffeine.q: Does caffeine in the morning undo the effects of a sleeping pill?
cl_benzo_hypnotic_morning_caffeine.short: After a sleeping pill, morning caffeine left young men less sleepy than a dummy capsule did.
cl_benzo_hypnotic_morning_caffeine.but: Their test scores were not clearly better, and nobody tested whether they could drive safely.
how: 80 young men slept in a lab after a sleeping pill or a dummy pill.
In the morning they got either caffeine or a dummy capsule.
Caffeine helped them stay awake on a nap test for most of the morning.

cl_benzo_hypnotic_accident_risk.q: Am I more likely to crash or fall when I start sleeping pills?
cl_benzo_hypnotic_accident_risk.short: Some studies found more crashes and falls soon after people started sleeping pills; others did not.
cl_benzo_hypnotic_accident_risk.but: These studies watched what happened and cannot prove the pills caused the accidents.
how: Researchers compared people taking these pills with people not taking them.
The risk looked highest in the first weeks after starting.
Older people taking these pills had more falls, especially when taking several medicines.

cl_benzo_hypnotic_residual_tolerance.q: If I take a sleeping pill every night, does the morning effect wear off?
cl_benzo_hypnotic_residual_tolerance.short: Nobody knows yet; for some pills the morning effect lasted or grew over a week.
cl_benzo_hypnotic_residual_tolerance.but: The studies were small and short, and none followed people for more than about two weeks.
how: Volunteers took a pill or a dummy pill every night for a few nights.
With flurazepam, driving got slightly worse over the week, not better.
Other pills behaved differently, so there is no single answer.
